Create request form configuration and idempotent submission receipts, retaining existing tickets and typed fields. Apply through pinned rer before the updated Worker serves traffic.

Create mailbox-verified contact alias storage without rewriting historical identities or granting address authority. Apply through pinned rer before the updated Worker serves traffic.

agentUpdateInstructions: Update from v0.4.5 to v0.4.6 without resetting. Stop writers and back up D1, R2, Durable Object state and private settings. Install frozen dependencies with Node 22.20.0, pnpm 10.12.4 and @runeditrun/rer 0.2.51. Rer applies the twelve listed missing migrations by name in filename order before the updated Worker starts, including 140-146 and 160-164 below already applied rows. It verifies recorded bytes and final readback; unknown names, changed bytes and uncertain history remain refused. Never delete, reorder or edit ledger rows. Existing participants remain unproven until independently verified. Preserve owner credentials, support history, imports, permissions, file bytes and erasure fences. Configure Gmail, Microsoft 365 or IMAP deliberately; mailbox connections and aliases do not grant authority to recipients. Keep uncertain external outcomes without replay and retain human Send.
publicReleaseNotes: HappyToHelp v0.4.6 adds gated R4 action macros, proven-recipient ticket notices and private team collaboration, plus R6 connected Gmail, Microsoft 365 and IMAP email, aliases, signatures, CC/BCC, threading, Suspended mail, operator tickets and vendor matching. Cc relay and AI replies reach independently proven addresses only. Unreadable mail is held without stalling healthy intake. The dropdown caret styling is included. Twelve migrations are added; back up and deploy with pinned rer 0.2.51, which accepts the real hosted migration history by name and recorded bytes. Do not reset or edit the ledger. R5 and R7b are not included. Hosted and paid-provider quality remain separately qualified; accessibility remains on owner HOLD. Production deployment is separate.
